source.notes: Typeset school paper with a real text layer. Printed header: Half Yearly Examination - 2018-19, BIOLOGY, Class : VIII, Time : 2 Hrs. + 15 min, Full Marks : 80 (durationMinutes 135 = 2 h + 15 min as printed). examYear 2019 is the later year of the printed session 2018-19. The PDF is a booklet imposition: PDF page 1 = printed page 1, PDF page 2 = printed pages 2 and 5, PDF page 3 = printed pages 3 and 4. Section A (Compulsory, 40 Marks) is Question 1 A–I; Section B (40 Marks) says 'Attempt any four' of Questions 2–6 (10 marks each), so the pack total (90) exceeds the 80-mark maximum; no choiceGroup is set because the choice is 'any four of five'. The '2.' label of Section B's first question is not printed (inferred). Where a printed mark covers a group of items it is kept as one entry with that total. Question 5 prints 3½ and 2½ marks for parts a and d; they are kept together as one 6-mark entry. No school name printed. No answer key.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text: Multiple choice question : i. Cortisone hormone is secreted by (a. Pancreas b. Pituitary gland c. Adrenal medulla d. Adrenal cortex) ii. Biotic components of ecosystem are (a. Producers b. Herbivores c. Carnivores d. All of these) iii. Evergreen broad-leaved tall trees are (a. Coniferous forest b. Temperature deciduous forest c. Tropical rainforest d. All of these) iv.
